questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What does CSS stand for?
questions.explanation: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets, used to style and lay out HTML elements.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to embed internal CSS styles within an HTML document?
questions.explanation: The <style> element is used to define internal CSS rules in HTML.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to link an external CSS stylesheet file?
questions.explanation: <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css"> is used to attach an external stylesheet.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property is used to change the background color of an element?
questions.explanation: The background-color property sets the background color of an element.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property changes the text color of an HTML element in CSS?
questions.explanation: The color property sets the foreground/text color of an element.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property specifies the font family/typeface of text?
questions.explanation: font-family specifies a prioritized list of font family names for the selected element.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property changes the font size of text?
questions.explanation: The font-size property sets the size of the font.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property makes text bold?
questions.explanation: font-weight: bold; (or numeric values like 700) sets the thickness of characters.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property renders text in italics?
questions.explanation: font-style: italic; sets font glyphs to italic style.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property adds an underline or strikethrough to text?
questions.explanation: text-decoration (e.g., text-decoration: underline;) decorates text with lines.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property controls the space INSIDE an element's border?
questions.explanation: Padding generates space around an element's content inside any defined borders.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property controls the space OUTSIDE an element's border?
questions.explanation: Margin creates space around elements, outside of any defined borders.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What is the correct syntax to define a solid red border of 2px width?
questions.explanation: The shorthand 'border: 2px solid red;' sets border-width, border-style, and border-color.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property rounded corners of an element's border?
questions.explanation: border-radius rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: How do you select an element with `id="header"` in CSS?
questions.explanation: The hash sign # is used as the ID selector in CSS.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: How do you select all elements with `class="card"` in CSS?
questions.explanation: The period . is used as the class selector in CSS.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which selector matches ALL elements on a webpage?
questions.explanation: The universal selector * matches all elements of any type.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: How do you add a comment in a CSS stylesheet?
questions.explanation: CSS comments start with /* and end with */.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property sets text horizontal alignment (left, right, center, justify)?
questions.explanation: text-align sets horizontal alignment of inline/text content within block elements.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which display value causes an element NOT to be displayed and removes it from layout flow?
questions.explanation: display: none; hides an element completely and removes its layout space.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What is the key difference between `display: none;` and `visibility: hidden;`?

options.A: display: none; hides element but keeps space; visibility: hidden; removes space
options.B: display: none; removes element from document flow entirely; visibility: hidden; hides element visually but leaves layout space
options.D: visibility: hidden; only works on images

questions.explanation: display: none removes the box from layout; visibility: hidden hides the element visually while reserving its space.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.topic: Units: px, em, rem, %, vw, and vh
questions.question: Which CSS unit represents a percentage of the viewport width?
questions.explanation: 1vw equals 1% of the total viewport width.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.topic: Units: px, em, rem, %, vw, and vh
questions.question: Which CSS unit represents a percentage of the viewport height?
questions.explanation: 1vh equals 1% of the total viewport height.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.topic: Units: px, em, rem, %, vw, and vh
questions.question: What does 'rem' unit stand for in CSS?
questions.explanation: rem units are calculated relative to the font-size of the root <html> element.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What is the shorthand order for four margin values: `margin: 10px 20px 30px 40px;`?
questions.explanation: Shorthand box values follow clockwise order: Top, Right, Bottom, Left (TRBL).

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What does `margin: 10px 20px;` specify?
questions.explanation: Two-value shorthand specifies vertical (Top/Bottom) then horizontal (Left/Right) margins.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property specifies how the total width and height of an element are calculated (content-box vs border-box)?
questions.explanation: box-sizing defines whether padding and border are included in element width/height.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What is the default value of the `box-sizing` property in standard CSS?
questions.explanation: The default value is content-box, where width/height apply only to content.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which color format allows defining opacity/transparency along with RGB in CSS?
questions.explanation: rgba() accepts Red, Green, Blue, and an Alpha value (0.0 to 1.0) for transparency.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property specifies an image to be used as a background?
questions.explanation: background-image specifies image sources (e.g., background-image: url('pic.png');).

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: What is the default `position` property value for HTML elements?
questions.explanation: Elements are positioned static by default, following normal document flow.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which position value positions an element relative to its normal position in document flow?
questions.explanation: position: relative offsets an element relative to where it would normally be placed.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which position value locks an element relative to the browser viewport so it stays fixed during scrolling?
questions.explanation: position: fixed anchors an element relative to the viewport window.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property controls letter capitalization (uppercase, lowercase, capitalize)?
questions.explanation: text-transform controls capitalization of text (e.g., uppercase, capitalize).

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which display property value initializes a flexible flex container layout in CSS?
questions.explanation: display: flex activates the Flexbox layout context for an element's children.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which flex property specifies the direction of flex items along the main axis (row vs column)?
questions.explanation: flex-direction establishes main axis direction (row, row-reverse, column, column-reverse).

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property aligns flex items along the MAIN axis of a flex container?
questions.explanation: justify-content aligns items along the main axis of a flex container.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property aligns flex items along the CROSS axis in a single-line flex container?
questions.explanation: align-items aligns items along the cross axis perpendicular to main axis.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which display property value initializes a CSS Grid container?
questions.explanation: display: grid initializes a grid formatting context.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS Grid property defines the column track sizes in a grid container?
questions.explanation: grid-template-columns defines column line names and track sizing functions.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS Grid unit represents a fraction of free available space in grid containers?
questions.explanation: The fr unit represents a fraction of available free space in grid layouts.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which pseudo-class applies styles when a user hovers over an element with a pointer?
questions.explanation: The :hover pseudo-class matches when the user interacts with an element with a pointing device.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which pseudo-class targets links that have already been clicked/visited by the user?
questions.explanation: The :visited pseudo-class selects links that the user has previously navigated to.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which pseudo-class targets an element when it receives keyboard or click focus (e.g., input field)?
questions.explanation: The :focus pseudo-class applies when an element receives focus (e.g. form fields).

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS property controls smooth property changes over a specified duration?
questions.explanation: transition allows property changes in CSS values to occur smoothly over time.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which transform function moves an element horizontally and/or vertically on screen?
questions.explanation: translate(x, y) repositions an element on the 2D plane.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which CSS rule is used to apply different styles conditionally based on media device features like screen width?
questions.explanation: @media queries apply CSS rules based on media type and feature conditions (e.g. screen width).

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: How are custom properties (CSS variables) defined in CSS?
questions.explanation: Custom properties are declared with a double hyphen prefix `--custom-name: value;`.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: How do you access the value of a custom property `--main-color` in CSS?
questions.explanation: The `var(--property-name)` function inserts the custom property value.

questions.subject: CSS
questions.question: Which property specifies line height/spacing between lines of text?
questions.explanation: line-height sets the vertical distance between lines of text.
